proves.claim: The three generated child-script files are listed by exact path and the lint does not cover them.

gate.logic-adapter-lints-env.generated-s.why: Their reads sit in strings a child process runs and cannot migrate to the adapter; an exact-path list keeps every other file covered.

proves.claim: A listed file with reads and no ceiling row reports nothing while an unlisted file with the same reads is reported.

gate.logic-adapter-lints-env.listed-file.why: Without this case the exemption could widen to other files unnoticed.
